# Housekeeping: host-web

## Authorized scope and smallest closable slice

Review the complete `hosts/host-web` Cargo package and its tests. Deliver practical, behavior-preserving cleanup in this package, or an evidenced no-change verdict when existing choices earn their cost. Cover all five user requests: repeated code/LoC; load-bearing test purposes; avoidable copies; applicable micro SIMD; and data structures that cap efficiency. The user requests two GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh agents concurrently; this overrides the default Terra implementation model for this workflow. Root Sol owns briefing, adversarial review, exact-path checkpoints, integration and remote synchronization.

## Frozen boundaries

Existing public APIs, feature behavior, canonical/wire identities, arithmetic order and per-lane rendered bits, latency/tail, link modes, smoothing and NaN/denormal rules remain contractual. Zero render allocations/frees, locks, I/O or syscalls; no runtime native ISA dispatch. Retain scalar tails, 4-lane Wasm/NEON and x86 AVX2/FMA. Preserve all feature and target configurations. Do not expand another open issue or change DSP algorithms. Read current related issue bodies before touching their subject; discoveries that require architecture or product decisions become bounded follow-ups and final owner questions.

## Implementation and test-value decisions

Prefer deleting or consolidating repetition to adding abstractions that increase total complexity. Assess every existing test or a clearly named homogeneous family by its plausible unique defect; remove trivial, redundant or obsolete cases only after identifying the surviving behavioral gate. Keep independent numeric/oracle, fault, allocation, queue, boundary and target tests. Add/rewrite tests only for a concrete uncovered defect, and state which plausible defect no existing test catches. No prose/source-grep tests, new bit-digest pins or exact resource-byte pins. Copies needed for ownership, snapshots or atomic admission stay unless the same semantics are proved with less work. Data structure changes must preserve deterministic order and bounded realtime work. Inspect applicable hot loops and generated code before claiming additional SIMD; recursive/stateful dependencies alone do not justify changing arithmetic.

## Objective gates and evidence

- Read all production and test files in this package; record concise findings for each of the five requests, concrete changed/deferred locations, and load-bearing test families with retained coverage for deletions.
- Run focused locked package tests and affected feature configurations; use existing downstream/RT/differential gates proportional to the changed contract. Check formatting and package clippy with warnings denied. Relevant Wasm and AArch64 compile checks are required for changed product code; record limitations candidly.
- Changes to DSP arithmetic or hot state need existing independent numeric and scalar/SIMD gates plus one-time base/head evidence when needed; no permanent comparison against the old implementation. Existing research remains the algorithm authority; no new algorithm or listening claim is authorized.
- Benchmarks are optional and descriptive. Any timed measurement freezes its workload/validator, passes zero-workload preflight, and runs exactly one invocation with one warmup/two measured rounds. No timing optimization loop, performance percentage or unsupported sound-quality claim.
- Root conducts one adversarial verdict per coherent attempt, at most five total attempts. Every new/rewritten test gets its unique-defect sentence in that verdict. No-change audits require the same five-axis review, not manufactured edits.
- Stop after a coherent compiling, focused-green tranche; root commits exact owned paths before further edits. Keep edits within `hosts/host-web` and this numbered spec. Independent crates use separate worktrees. Root pushes promptly and updates this GitHub issue with evidence; close only after PASS and evidence upstream, verifying remote state. Merge through the required qualification check and remove clean completed worktrees.

Approved 2026-10-01 by root Sol within the user's crate-by-crate housekeeping request. Attempt 1 is authorized with the frozen scope/gates above. Owner questions are collected for the final report; routine reversible cleanup proceeds autonomously. Scope is this package's housekeeping, not completion of pre-existing feature/bug issues.

GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh worker B read all 55 package files: Cargo/Rust modules, integration tests, examples, JS/TS/declarations, stem-store implementation/provenance/fakes/tests, browser fixtures and qualification/deployment/mutation support. Related current #560, #763, #1020, #1053, #896, #897, #1106 and #1165 scopes were checked before subject edits. Root approved the bounded proposal. No dependency, JS production, ABI, generator, DSP arithmetic or feature change.

#### Five-axis findings

- **Repeated code/LoC:** one private request-header decoder now receives each caller's original header/value/edit sizes and capacity. Short header remains invalid argument; malformed fields/reserved bytes still precede body-length checks; short valid body remains buffer-too-small and trailing bytes invalid argument. Removed the identical `ready_host` alias, unused identity-session argument and repeated ring-default assertion.
- **Test value:** removed `selective_meter_and_readiness_descriptive_timing`, its private timing/FNV/JSONL helpers and the test-only pre-#520 readiness bypass. No current scripts/CI/environment-vocabulary caller exists; the historical handoff entry classifies it as an out-of-scope benchmark. Historical records remain. All current behavioral families below remain; no new test or corpus was added.
- **Copies:** successful EQ and input-filter preparation encodes directly into the existing retained result buffer after every fallible decode/design step. EQ still clears its full 944-byte capacity; input filters clear only the valid prefix, retaining the old untouched suffix and zero reserved record words. Refusal leaves prior result bytes/result length intact, while rejection counters retain their original updates. Candidate seeds/edits/targets and compiler/session ownership copies remain for transactional preparation. Shared constant source planes borrow one Vec; paired host comparisons borrow the two live outputs until comparison completes. JS caller snapshots, transferable ownership and independent returned arrays remain necessary publication/lifetime boundaries.
- **Micro SIMD:** this package adapts/queues PCM and control data; it does not own sample arithmetic. No extra ISA body is justified for checked ID/header processing or control preparation. The shipping Wasm generated-code gate passed 12 four-lane kernel bodies, no eight-lane body, and the render/meter/command call-graph allocation/drop/trap contracts. Native AVX2/FMA and upstream scalar/tail/NEON behavior remain unchanged; no timing improvement is claimed.
- **Data structures:** removed the transient `compile_ready` BTreeMap and used binary search over the same immutable canonical track IDs for producer/observation binding and selected-observation lookup. Source seeks likewise search normalized source IDs using the original byte comparison. `session::compile_session` sorts tracks/sources (`compile.rs:128/131`); builtins preparation collects normalized tracks (`lib.rs:3518`), and private Ready ownership does not reorder them. Diagnostic/construction order and first effect-slot match remain unchanged. Spectrum collection decoding advances one checked packed-ID offset after each validated entry, replacing repeated prior-entry sums while preserving count/budget/ID/target/channel refusal order. Bounded queues, request Maps and retained dense tables keep their ordering/ownership purposes.

## Root adversarial verdict: PASS — attempt 1

Root Sol read all four changed Rust diffs and the complete package/family evidence, independently checked normalized sorting and immutable transferred handle order, and inspected both preparers, target-count bounds, fixed wire writes and packed spectrum refusal ordering. Shared header guards use the same two fixed 32-byte shapes and original capacities. EQ clears its full capacity and input filters only their prefix; every fallible step remains before retained-result writes and existing failure counters/lengths stay fixed. Binary search is justified by canonical sorted owners, while effect-slot first-match order remains unchanged. Borrowed test planes/results stay alive through submission/comparison.

Root inspected actual debug/release, strict lint, foreign compile, official shipping artifact/callgraph/kernel, raw-Wasm and hermetic logs. The premature incomplete-assets refusal is candidly preserved; its completed-builder replay uses the unchanged gate. Required real-browser delivery qualification remains pending, and no measured speedup or extra SIMD is claimed.

Rewritten-test purpose: `finite_source_boundary_requires_only_the_actual_final_marker` catches early EOF or an unmarked final chunk being admitted by the host and verifies correctly marked recovery on the same host, a finite-region boundary the readiness/peak tests do not exercise. Its complete original inputs and assertions remain. Other helper/signature/borrow substitutions preserve the named surviving families' exact schedules and comparisons; the repeated default-ring assertion is subsumed by the unchanged earlier assertion and resource/stall owner. The retired ignored timer and pre-520 bypass provide no unique current behavioral gate; current independent metric, readiness, fold, loss, lease and delayed-window owners remain.

All five requested axes are complete. Public/wire/DSP/feature behavior, atomic admission and callback contracts remain fixed. No new owner question or test/harness is introduced.
